title: AI is already rejecting your job application
description:
AI is already rejecting your job application before a human ever sees it. ATS filters reject most CVs in seconds and AI video interviews now make the call long before a human gets involved. In this video I break down the 3 changes my students make to beat the algorithm and start landing offers.

IN THIS VIDEO:
0:00 Why you're stuck in the rejection cycle
1:29 Change 1: How ATS actually works
4:08 Knockout questions + CV ranking
5:46 Write for humans, not systems
6:42 Change 2: Master AI video interviews
9:40 Change 3: Make AI your unfair advantage
11:00 What to do next

ABOUT ME:
I dropped out of university at 19 to build recruitment software and ATS systems used by hiring teams. For years I spoke to hundreds of hiring managers and recruiters every day, learning exactly how candidates get filtered, shortlisted, and hired from the inside. I started coaching friends through their job search using what I'd seen, then raised investment, built a software company, and hired my own team. I've seen hiring from every angle.

Today I help job seekers land offers faster using a proven 3-step system. I've coached hundreds of candidates into roles at firms like JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, EY, and PwC and many more.
